events.text:
## Recommendation

- **Go to St. Joseph.** It's my top pick, but this is a low-confidence call because no pier reports exist.
- **Ratings for this week (my estimate, not from pier reports):** St. Joseph 2 (average), South Haven 2, Grand Haven 2, Muskegon 2. The ports are close, so the choice rests mainly on St. Joseph's boat results and recent wind.
- **Expect to fish deep.** Water is about 76 F, well above the 52-58 F range salmon prefer, so I'd start deep and let the boat reports guide depth.
- **Fish early and late.** Boat anglers did best in low light.

## Why

- St. Joseph had the best recent boat result: the Aug 3 report rated it good (quality 3) with meat rigs and spoons, and noted that fish moved in toward the end of the week (St. Joseph, 2022-08-03).
- I'd expect pier fishing to be harder than boat fishing at 76 F, because the boat fish were 65-140 feet down and the pier can't reach that depth.
- I'd expect upwelling to help St. Joseph more than the other ports right now, since it had 17 hours of upwelling wind in the last three days, which is the sign of cold water moving toward the pier.

## Evidence

**Recent reports (all boat reports, none from piers):**
- Aug 3, St. Joseph: "Salmon fishing was good… Meat rigs and spoons were catching most of these fish" (quality 3, 100+ ft of water).
- Aug 3, Muskegon: quality 3 (good), salmon 65-130 ft down in 140-250 ft of water, glow spoons, meat rigs, and green or white flies.
- Aug 3, Grand Haven: quality 2 (average), best bite 65-140 ft down on green flies and meat rigs in 120-220 ft of water.
- Aug 3, South Haven: quality 1 (below average), "the best water was around 100 feet."
- Jul 14, Grand Haven and Muskegon: quality 0 (slow), when upwelling was strong for a week.

**Past seasons (similar water temperature, 2022 only in these data):**
- The matching weeks within 14 days of Aug 9 at about 76 F are the same Aug 3 reports above. There is no older multi-year match in this data, so no separate history to add.

**Conditions now (summary for the week before Aug 9; live data was unavailable):**
- Upwelling wind in the last three days: St. Joseph 17 hours, South Haven 23, Grand Haven 13, Muskegon 12.
- Buoy surface water: about 76 F at all four ports, +1 F over the week.
- Satellite pierhead water (not measured by the buoy): about 77 F at St. Joseph, -1 F over the last three days.
- Cold-layer depth was not returned, so I can't say where the 52-58 F water sits.

## Caveats

- **No pier reports exist.** The newest reports are from Aug 3, six days old, and every salmon report in the last four weeks is from boats. My pier ratings are inferences from boat results and wind.
- **Conditions are a summary, not a live forecast.** I have no wind forecast for this weekend, so check the wind before you go.
- **Pierhead water is satellite-based.** The satellite can lag 1-2 days, and the buoys sit miles offshore.
- **Lure and depth advice comes from boat reports** and may not match what works from a pier.

## Sources

- Aug 3 bulletin (all four ports): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3268d0b
- Jul 20 bulletin (St. Joseph): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/323f6bf
- Jul 14 bulletin (Grand Haven, Muskegon): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/321350c
